summary: Strong coverage of core requirements (manifest parsing, license classification, compliance reporting, workflow structure). Proper use of Pester mocking and end-to-end act integration across three fixture scenarios. Good test organization with clear Describe/Context blocks and proper fixture-based approach. However, limited rigor around edge cases (empty manifests, malformed JSON, special characters, case sensitivity) and error scenarios (missing license database, malformed config). Error handling paths (e.g., -FailOnViolation flag) appear undertested. Would reliably catch basic regressions in happy-path workflows and main functionality but may miss subtle bugs in edge cases or error handling.
